dedupe_keys.name: los angeles county public emergency map shelters and evacuation assistance

description: This Los Angeles County layer, a view of a hosted feature layer behind the county's public emergency map, shows emergency shelters, evacuation centres and other services set up in response to an incident. The county explains that shelters are temporary facilities providing housing and basic services until people can return home or find other housing, while evacuation centres are temporary facilities not used for overnight stays. Fields give assistance type, operational and active status, release and archive flags, incident name, location name and full address, hours, whether pets are allowed, English and Spanish map labels and details, and a URL, with edit timestamps. Coverage: Los Angeles County, California. Access: free feature service; the item was modified in January 2025. Licence: none stated on the hub. Caveats: an incident-driven layer whose contents change or empty between emergencies, and archived records may not be exposed. Simulation uses: wildfire and earthquake evacuation and shelter models, and live inputs for emergency digital twins. Related records: the FEMA ESF-6 open shelters layer and the Miami-Dade open evacuation centres layer.
